volume_test.en: This is the volume check. Can you hear me?
volume_test.sw: Hiki ni kipimo cha sauti. Unanisikia?

walk_away.en: Go and stand against the wall. Face the phone.
walk_away.sw: Nenda usimame karibu na ukuta. Uelekee simu.

corr_tilt.en: The phone is tilted. Please straighten it.

corr_step_in.en: I cannot see you. Stand in front of the phone.

corr_head_cut.en: Your head or feet are cut off. Step back.
corr_head_cut.sw: Kichwa au miguu haionekani. Rudi nyuma.

corr_too_far.en: Too far. Step forward one step.
corr_too_far.sw: Uko mbali sana. Sogea mbele hatua moja.

corr_too_close.en: Too close. Step back one step.
corr_too_close.sw: Uko karibu sana. Rudi nyuma hatua moja.

corr_turn_right.en: Turn a little more to your right.

corr_arms_away.en: Move your arm away from your body.
corr_arms_away.sw: Weka mkono mbali na mwili wako.

corr_arms_forward.en: Let your arms hang a little forward.

corr_sheet_flat.en: Hold the sheet flat, black square facing the phone.
corr_sheet_flat.sw: Shika karatasi vizuri, mraba mweusi uelekee simu.

corr_fingers.en: Move your fingers off the black square.

corr_too_dark.en: Too dark. Turn on a light or face a window.
corr_too_dark.sw: Giza sana. Washa taa au uelekee dirisha.

corr_too_bright.en: Too bright behind you. Move away from the window.
corr_too_bright.sw: Mwanga mwingi nyuma yako. Ondoka dirishani.

turn_right.en: Turn to your right so your right shoulder faces the phone. Hold the sheet flat on your right hip.
turn_right.sw: Geuka kulia ili bega la kulia lielekee simu. Shika karatasi kwenye nyonga ya kulia.

try_again.en: Please hold still and try again.

finished.en: Finished. Walk back to the phone.

help_1.en: Wear fitted clothes. Have your measuring sheet ready.
help_1.sw: Vaa nguo za kubana. Andaa karatasi ya kupimia.

help_2.en: Stand the phone upright on a chair, then press start.
help_2.sw: Simamisha simu kwenye kiti, kisha bonyeza anza.

help_3.en: Stand three big steps away. Hold the sheet flat on your chest.
help_3.sw: Simama hatua tatu kubwa. Shika karatasi kifuani.

help_4.en: When asked, turn side on. Hold the sheet on your right hip.
help_4.sw: Ukiambiwa, geuka ubavu. Shika karatasi kwenye nyonga ya kulia.

help_5.en: Listen to the phone. It will tell you what to change.
